brief:
Israeli Occupation Forces killed 16 Palestinians, including six women and a child, and wounded at least 36 others between September 30 and October 3, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. The deaths occurred across multiple areas of Gaza Strip in a series of attacks and gunfire incidents.

The killings spanned four days of operations targeting various locations throughout the territory during the reported period.
dek: Israeli Occupation Forces (IOF) killed 16 Palestinians, including six women and a child, and injured at least 36 others between Wednesday noon, 30 September, and Saturday dawn, 3 October 2026, in a series of attacks and gunfire targeting various areas across the Gaza Strip, according to information collected by the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights…
title: Israeli forces kill 16 Palestinians including six women and child in Gaza
